numeric: Simple split/reference-adjusted close averages with relative1e-12 equality tolerance. Current and previous relevant MA finite in same segment. No assumed cross ordering, no confirmation buffer or optimized filter.
whole_path_population: Start at OPEN after first observed eligible close on/after analysis start: KR contemporaneous rank1..200; US contemporaneous SEC point-share estimated cap>=2bn. This is a stock already selected at that point. Thereafter EVERY signal is processed regardless of later cap membership, so cap changes do not become another timing rule. Interval descriptive main tables require qualifying market cap AT THE INTERVAL'S START SIGNAL; out-of-scope/missing cap segments remain in continuous wealth and separate all-interval tables. Never retroactively remove bankrupt/ended or later-small stocks.
initial_state: Primary starts in avoidance phase at inception OPEN, waiting for first actual buy cross. No backfilling a past buy signal from before study selection. For100% overlay hold all initial capital as cash; for50% overlay hold50% stock plus50% cash. A buy signal at the qualifying close can execute at inception open. Also run initially-fully-invested sensitivity with otherwise identical signals to expose start-state dependence. Initial partial interval is marked left-truncated, excluded from completed signal-to-signal distributions but INCLUDED in full wealth and time accounting.
state_machine: Two phases: holding after buy fill; avoidance after sell fill. At each close, only the signal relevant to CURRENT phase can trigger a next-open order. If buy and sell signals coincide, holding schedules sell, avoidance schedules buy; one action only. On next open apply pending action then evaluate that day's close in the new state. Continued or repeated irrelevant signals do not trade. No assumed temporal order, stop/profit/maximum duration or cap-driven forced exit.
execution: Close signal -> next consecutive valid market-session OPEN, never same-close fills. If next required bar missing/invalid, no fill and no phase change; wait for a later actual relevant cross. Suspensions/gaps do not liquidate shares or erase cash; reset indicators until valid warmup. Trade return uses actual adjusted open ratios; segment final mark is last valid close without a forced final trade. Primary fractional shares, small price-taker; extra one-session delayed-open sensitivity.
exposure: Nine signal pairs each at100% sell and50% sell. In holding phase all available strategy capital is stock. In avoidance phase100% sells all current stock;50% sells half current stock and retains half. Net sale cash alone is reinvested at buy; repeat based on current holdings. Initial cash earns0 baseline;4% annual sensitivity. No leverage, borrowing, unrelated deposits, integer-share rounding or assumed fills for missing bars.
cost_basis: Same clearly labeled all-in cost scenarios as original six, not a historical statutory tax table. Initial units are endowed to both arms; first later buy uses surcharge. Final valuation has no fictional liquidation fee. Actual investor capital-gains/withholding/FX excluded. US unchanged-signal total-return-unit sensitivity uses Yahoo adjclose/close; KR4% continuous stock-income sensitivity is hypothetical, not actual dividends.
segments: Partition every observed date after inception into holding or avoidance by executed state. Complete holding segment buy-open -> sell-open, avoidance sell-open -> buy-open; share boundary OPEN exactly, no unallocated or overlapping time. Terminal segment -> last valid close and left-truncated initial segment both retained with flags. Report close-signal dates and fill dates separately. Intraday minimum/maximum excludes boundary-exit day's post-open range. Include open-to-close prices on entry day and exit OPEN in excursion statistics.
segment_metrics: Raw price return/end-start, trading sessions and calendar duration, low-based adverse and high-based favorable excursion, close-path maximum drawdown. Holding: positive/negative returns; avoidance: falling=avoided decline, rising=missed rise, equal. Mean/median/P5/P25/P75/P95, conditional gains/losses,50%-sale cycle share effect and100%-sale effect at completed buy. Never invert low-excursion probability into executable saving probability. Main tables eligible complete signal-to-signal intervals; censored/truncated/all-interval counts explicit.
path_metrics: Time-order cash/share ledger including ALL segments, state duty cycle, wealth-weighted equity exposure, trade frequency/cost drag, final wealth/CAGR/MDD, downside/upside capture and drawdown improvement relative to same-inception hold. Fixed2016-01-04 eligible inception cohort and fresh2023-04-03 cohort, equal initial capital with no rebalance/future entrants. Stale last marks flagged; zero-stock-value sensitivity after early endpoint. Per-stock variable-inception distributions separately labeled; never pool them as one real portfolio.

Quarter blocks bootstrap4000 seed20261018, simultaneous Bonferroni95% intervals for36 market x9pairs x2exposures. Show point effects and intervals. Holding and avoidance event means use crossed symbol x start-quarter bootstrap2000 for representative pooled families; conditionals and rankings exploratory, not adjusted discoveries. interpretation: Recommend no timing pair just for low drawdown or high price-win frequency. Explain exposure reduction vs signal timing using a passive matched-exposure diagnostic (ex-post attribution, not another selected tradable strategy), annual downside/upside capture and complete wealth. A robust winning pair requires net heldout wealth advantage with statistical/economic support and consistent cost/initial/income/delay sensitivity. Report no meaningful edge when evidence fails; do not optimize rules to improve results.
